authorization: October 7 Fernando authorizes acting on the board QEC steer with unlimited-ish QPU budget; no scientific holdout change.
analysis: Publish every cell and block, physical vs encoded vs dynamic-corrected overlap errors, syndrome frequencies, shot standard errors and charged time. Intentional X/Z faults test mechanism, not naturally occurring error rates. Physical X0/X1/X2 are duplicated matched-reference circuits. Two same-time blocks do not establish calibration-day replication. No QSVR fitting, postselection, holdout reads or advantage claim.
operation: Restricted logical phase map, logical RZ on one data qubit, one parity-check round and conditional single-X correction before coherent decoding. Code corrects one X; does not correct Z. Compare equal logical input/idle/shot counts; report extra qubits/gates/duration rather than claiming equal gate cost.
execution: Prepare and validate code/circuit/plan hashes before submit. Exclusive intent per device/block before API call; collect existing jobs only. Never retry an ambiguous submission. Device unavailable is recorded, not silently replaced. Each block submits all 90 circuits as one job.
